HAND SHOWER WITH SLIDE BAR
Installation Guide

Before you begin
Read these instructions all the way through before starting. Installation takes about 30 minutes for most showers. If you are mounting the slide bar into tile, allow extra time for drilling.

What's in the box
1 hand shower
1 shower hose, 69 in (175 cm)
1 slide bar with sliding holder
2 wall brackets
1 diverter
2 rubber washers
4 mounting screws
4 wall anchors

Tools you will need
- Drill with a 1/4 in masonry bit for tile, or a standard bit for drywall
- Adjustable wrench
- Phillips screwdriver
- Level
- Pencil
- Plumber's tape
- Soft cloth, to protect the finish from wrench marks

Installation
1. Turn off the water supply to the shower, or shut the main valve.
2. Unscrew the shower head from the shower arm with the adjustable wrench. Clean old tape and mineral buildup off the shower arm threads.
3. Wrap the shower arm threads clockwise with three turns of plumber's tape.
4. Thread the diverter onto the shower arm by hand, then snug it a quarter turn with the wrench. Wrap the jaws in the soft cloth so the finish is not scratched. Thread the shower head onto the front outlet of the diverter.
5. Hold the slide bar against the wall below the shower arm. Use the level to make it plumb and mark the two wall bracket positions with the pencil.
6. Drill a hole at each mark. Tap a wall anchor into each hole until it sits flush with the tile.
7. Fasten the wall brackets with the mounting screws, then snap the slide bar into the brackets.
8. Place a rubber washer in each end of the shower hose. Connect one end to the bottom outlet of the diverter and the other end to the hand shower. Hand-tighten only.
9. Peel the clear film and the tab off the spray face of the hand shower.
10. Turn the water back on. Switch the diverter between the shower head and the hand shower, and check every connection for leaks. If a connection drips, tighten it another eighth of a turn.

Specifications
Flow rate: 1.75 gpm (6.6 L/min) at 80 psi
Maximum water pressure: 125 psi
Hose length: 69 in (175 cm)

Care and cleaning
Wipe the hand shower and slide bar with a soft, damp cloth and dry them. Do not use abrasive cleaners, scouring pads or cleaners that contain bleach; they damage the finish. If the spray nozzles clog with mineral deposits, rub them with your thumb while the water runs. For heavy buildup, soak the spray face in an even mix of white vinegar and water for an hour, then rinse.

WARNING
The hand shower docks in its holder with magnets. Keep the hand shower at least 6 in (15 cm) away from a pacemaker, defibrillator or other implantable medical device, since strong magnets can interfere with it. Keep small parts such as washers out of reach of children; they are a choking hazard.
